note: Private campground and glamping retreat about 10 km from Elk Island National Park, near Fort Saskatchewan. Front sites (1-18) are open, near the entrance; back sites (19-36) are more private, and 25-29 are treed. Domes, yurts and cabins too. Pets to 50 lb, RV area only. --Claude
